title: エルコンドルパサー登場！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa enters the ring of the Twinkle Series. Her goal? To be the strongest racer in the world!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Surrounded by strong friends like Special Week and Grass Wonder, she works hard towards her goal…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All so that she may one day take off for races across the world. With a vigorous shout, El Condor Pasa prepares to make her dreams come true.
